info.name: Care Platform API — Staging
info.description:
M1 + M2 + M3 + M4 + M5 (Catalog, Pricing, Inventory, Purchasing, Customers & POS Cart) staging environment collection.

Base URL: https://api.care-systems.site

All endpoints require Bearer JWT unless noted.

Mutation requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) automatically get an Idempotency-Key header.

M3 adds Tenant Admin endpoints for Inventory management under /api/v1/admin/inventory/.

M4 adds Tenant Admin endpoints for Purchasing management under /api/v1/admin/purchasing/ (suppliers, purchase orders, goods receipts).

M5 adds Tenant Admin customer reference endpoints under /api/v1/admin/customers/ and canonical POS Draft Cart endpoints under /api/v1/pos/carts/. POS Cart temporarily uses a tenant JWT through PosOperatorGuard; device and Card/PIN identity are not implemented. Tracked credential variables remain blank.
